This podcast section collects episodes on health metrics, infectious disease analytics, data science, AI, and public health modelling. The episodes translate technical ideas such as DALYs, predictive algorithms, spatial analysis, and disease burden into accessible conversations for analysts, students, and applied researchers.

## Featured episodes

- [The New Science of Fighting Infectious Disease](posts/the-new-science-of-fighting-infectious-disease/) explains health metrics, machine learning, spatial modelling, and One Health thinking.
- [From Plague Bills to Predictive Algorithms](posts/from-plague-bills-to-predictive-algorithms/) traces health intelligence from historical death records to outbreak prediction.
- [Valuing Human Life in a Spreadsheet](posts/valuing-human-life-in-a-spreadsheet/) connects data, economics, and health metrics.
